---
title: "Sarasota County at a glance"
---

Explore population, income, housing, and poverty estimates for Sarasota County, Florida, using the 2019–2023 American Community Survey (ACS) five-year data.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)

has_api_key <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY"))
```

## Community estimates

The table gives estimates and their 90% margins of error. These are survey estimates, not exact counts.

```{r}
#| label: census-data
#| include: false

if (has_api_key) {
  acs <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = "FL",
    county = "Sarasota",
    year = 2023,
    survey = "acs5",
    output = "wide",
    variables = c(
      population = "B01003_001",
      median_age = "B01002_001",
      median_household_income = "B19013_001",
      median_home_value = "B25077_001",
      poverty_universe = "B17001_001",
      below_poverty = "B17001_002",
      occupied_housing = "B25003_001",
      renter_occupied = "B25003_003"
    )
  )

  summary_data <- tibble(
    Measure = c("Population", "Median age", "Median household income", "Median home value"),
    Estimate = c(
      scales::comma(acs$estimate_population),
      paste0(round(acs$estimate_median_age, 1), " years"),
      scales::dollar(acs$estimate_median_household_income),
      scales::dollar(acs$estimate_median_home_value)
    ),
    `90% margin of error` = c(
      scales::comma(acs$moe_population),
      paste0("+/-", round(acs$moe_median_age, 1), " years"),
      scales::dollar(acs$moe_median_household_income),
      scales::dollar(acs$moe_median_home_value)
    )
  )

  share_data <- tibble(
    measure = c("Below poverty line", "Renter-occupied housing"),
    share = c(
      acs$estimate_below_poverty / acs$estimate_poverty_universe,
      acs$estimate_renter_occupied / acs$estimate_occupied_housing
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

if (has_api_key) {
  knitr::kable(summary_data)
} else {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "To load the Census estimates, add your free Census API key. See the [About page](about.qmd) for setup instructions."
  )
}
```

## Poverty and housing

These percentages are calculated from the ACS estimates shown in the source tables. Margins of error for the calculated percentages are not shown.

```{r}
#| label: shares-chart
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing the estimated share of residents below the poverty line and occupied housing that is renter-occupied"

if (has_api_key) {
  print(
    ggplot(share_data, aes(x = measure, y = share)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#147d73", width = 0.65) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of estimate") +
      theme_minimal()
  )
}
```

Source: [U.S. Census Bureau, 2019–2023 ACS five-year estimates](https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data.html). See the [About page](about.qmd) for variable definitions and setup.
